model.name: gemma-4-26b
model.about: Google Gemma 4, mixture of experts (26B, 4B active), BF16 as released. Apache-2.0. October retest: vLLM 0.31.0, Gemma tool/reasoning parsers and tool chat template, explicit non-thinking requests, no free JSON whitespace. September's vLLM 0.30.0 runs repeated tokens under strict JSON; those results retain their original configuration. Compatibility of this configuration must be checked with --quick before a full run.

answers.sql:
SELECT
  t2.DSPLY_NM,
  COUNT(t1.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL t2
  ON t1.CHNL_K = t2.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  t2.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS T1
WHERE
  T1.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND T1.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
  T2.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(T1.ALRT_ID) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT T1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR T2
  ON T1.JUR_K = T2.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT T3
  ON T1.BUS_DT_K = T3.DT_K
WHERE T3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  T2.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  t2.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(t1.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR t2
  ON t1.BR_K = t2.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  t2.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  COUNT(t1.CD_DSPT_F_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS t1
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t2
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K
WHERE
  t2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31';

SELECT
  t2.DSPLY_NM,
  COUNT(t1.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG t2
  ON t1.CMPLT_CTG_K = t2.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t2.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  c.CCY_NM,
  d.CAL_DT,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  c.CCY_NM,
  d.CAL_DT
ORDER BY
  c.CCY_NM,
  d.CAL_DT;

SELECT
  f.MKT_ID,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MKT_ID;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE CUST_K IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM (SELECT CUST_K, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY INGST_AT DESC, VRSN_NBR DESC) as rn FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST) t WHERE rn > 1);

SELECT
  t1.ACCT_TYP_CD1,
  COUNT(t1.ACCT_K) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT AS t1
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY
  t1.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
  b.CTY_NM,
  COUNT(f.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b
  ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY
  b.CTY_NM;

SELECT
  AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31';

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY 1;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  ON d.CUST_K = f.CUST_K
  AND f.BUS_DT_K IN (
    SELECT
      dt.DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )
WHERE f.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS percentage_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  t2.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  COUNT(t1.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG t2
  ON t1.CMPLT_CTG_K = t2.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t1.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  t2.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM,
  COUNT(f.ALRT_ID) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
  ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR, SUM(f.TXN_CNT) AS total_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
  T1.DSPLY_NM,
  SUM(T2.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_loan_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD AS T1
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT AS T2
  ON T1.LN_PRD_K = T2.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS T3
  ON T2.BUS_DT_K = T3.DT_K
WHERE T3.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  T1.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t1.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST AS t2
  ON t1.CUST_K = t2.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE
  t2.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND t1.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH branch_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rnk
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT 
    RGN_CD1,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_count
FROM branch_counts
WHERE rnk = 1;

SELECT
  t1.MRCH_CTG_CD1,
  SUM(t1.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE AS t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t2
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K
WHERE
  t2.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND t2.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  t1.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY
  total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  t2.BUS_ID,
  SUM(t1.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST t2
  ON t1.CUST_K = t2.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE
  t3.CAL_DT >= '2025-01-01' AND t3.CAL_DT <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  t2.BUS_ID
ORDER BY
  total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1, SUM(t1.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3 ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY t2 ON t1.CCY_K = t2.CCY_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT atm.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_atm
  ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt_atm.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
  ON atm.CUST_K = wr.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_wr
  ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt_wr.DT_K
WHERE dt_atm.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt_wr.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  COUNT(t1.WR_TRF_F_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS t1
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t2
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K
WHERE
  t2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY
  d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY
  d.CAL_YR_NBR;
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;
UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT' WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca';

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = TRUE) AS weekend_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = FALSE) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ACCT_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON t1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D t2 ON t1.ACCT_K = t2.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON t2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
  AND d2.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  AND t1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < (t2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9);

-- Interpretation: 
-- Calculating the number of unique accounts where the closing balance on 31 Dec 2025 is less than 90% of the closing balance on 30 Jun 2025.
-- Assumes 'closing balance' refers to CLSNG_BAL_AMT in F_ACCT_BAL_D.
-- Assumes BUS_DT_K links to D_DT.DT_K to resolve calendar dates.

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT curr.BUS_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST curr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST prev ON curr.BUS_ID = prev.BUS_ID
  AND curr.VRSN_NBR = prev.VRSN_NBR + 1
WHERE curr.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT
    COUNT(t.CUST_K)
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE
        d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        f.CUST_K
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.QTR_NBR) = 4
) t;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
JOIN bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp ON d.CUST_K = dsp.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_dsp ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt_dsp.DT_K
WHERE dt_dsp.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_wr ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt_wr.DT_K
    WHERE wr.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
      AND dt_wr.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

/* Assumption: 2025 refers to CAL_YR_NBR from the D_DT dimension. */

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT t1.LN_ID)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON t1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS t2 ON t1.LN_ID = t2.LN_ID
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON t2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = '2024-06-30'
  AND t1.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND d2.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  AND t2.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT
  t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t1.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY t2
  ON t1.CCY_K = t2.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
GROUP BY
  d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY
  d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT t1.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST t1
  INNER JOIN bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC t2 ON t1.CUST_K = t2.CUST_K
  INNER JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3 ON t2.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE
  t1.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t1.CUST_SNC_DT) = 2025
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t3.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT
    t1.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t1.BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST t1
WHERE
    t1.EFF_FRM_DT <= '2023-06-30'
    AND t1.EFF_TO_DT >= '2023-06-30'
GROUP BY
    t1.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        c.BUS_ID
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC) as rnk
    FROM CustomerTotals
)
SELECT 
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_wire_amount DESC;

SELECT
    t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS currency_share_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY t2
    ON t1.CCY_K = t2.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE
    t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    t2.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K) AS wire_transfer_count,
    SUM(COUNT(f.WR_TRF_F_K)) OVER (ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN t.ORGNL_AMT
      ELSE t.ORGNL_AMT / r.MID_RT
    END
  ) AS total_wire_transfer_amt_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D r
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = r.BUS_DT_K
  AND t.CCY_K = r.CCY_K
  AND r.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND t.CCY_CD1 <> 'EUR' OR t.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' -- Logic handled in CASE
  -- Note: The user specified rates are units of currency per 1 EUR (e.g., 1.1 USD/EUR).
  -- Therefore, EUR = Amount / Rate. If CCY is EUR, no conversion needed.
;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR,
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS decline_share_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY decline_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  t2.CCY_NM,
  SUM(t1.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY AS t2
  ON t1.CCY_K = t2.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY t2.CCY_NM;

SELECT
  T2.DSPLY_NM,
  COUNT(T1.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN T1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL T2
  ON T1.CHNL_K = T2.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT T3
  ON T1.BUS_DT_K = T3.DT_K
WHERE T3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  T2.DSPLY_NM;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE;

SELECT
  J."	ext{DSPLY_NM}" AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(A.ALRT_ID) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT A
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR J
  ON A.JUR_K = J.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D
  ON A.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  J."DSPLY_NM";

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM,
  COUNT(atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS br
  ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE
  dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  COUNT(t1.CD_DSPT_F_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS t1
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS t2
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t2.DT_K
WHERE
  t2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K)
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
  f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT = '2025-08-31';

SELECT
  t2.DSPLY_NM,
  COUNT(t1.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT t1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG t2
  ON t1.CMPLT_CTG_K = t2.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
  ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K
WHERE
  t3.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  t2.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
  c.CCY_NM,
  d.CAL_DT,

WITH CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS business_id,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY 
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        c.BUS_ID
),
RankedCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        segment_code,
        business_id,
        total_wire_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC) as rnk
    FROM CustomerTotals
)
SELECT 
    segment_code,
    business_id,
    total_wire_amount
FROM RankedCustomers
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_wire_amount DESC;

FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t1

    ON t1.CCY_K = t2.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT t3
    ON t1.BUS_DT_K = t3.DT_K

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR

SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN trf.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN trf.ORGNL_AMT
      ELSE trf.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT
    END
  ) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
  ON trf.BUS_DT_K = fx.BUS_DT_K
  AND trf.CCY_K = fx.CCY_K
  AND fx.CCY_CD1 != 'EUR'
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d.mth_nbr
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;
